product_method: Original product, cap, hand and sauce photographs are embedded without generative redrawing and clipped using SVG photo layouts. Sauce stream is scaled to connect to food. Food and background are generated. Hero and bottom retain prior v4 studio packshots.

prompts.name: easy-mayo-concept-fries-action-v5.png
prompts.prompt: NEW premium mouthwatering action food advertising photograph, WIDE 16:9 landscape. Reference1 defines energetic squeezing composition, NOT its orange brand, NOT red sauce or pepperoni. Reference2 is exact MINES EASY MAYO product identity. Food and creamy flowing sauce are the HERO, filling 65-75% of the frame, extremely appetizing sharp texture and glossy highlights. Bottle is a supporting prop held upside down by a real adult hand entering from top-right, partially cropped by top, only 20-25% of frame area. Preserve reference2 straight RECTANGULAR paper sleeve over subtly curved plastic bottle, white open round flip cap and existing MINES/EASY MAYO/Korean flavor print; no redesign. Freeze a thick continuous ribbon of mayonnaise descending from the nozzle and just landing/coiling onto food, with a few small believable airborne garnish elements, captured high-speed commercial photography. Dynamic diagonal composition, slight steam, lively dramatic but tasteful softbox lighting. Sauce must look like real mayonnaise: creamy pale beige, tiny sparse flecks, thick rounded folds, not runny orange liquid or explosive water splash. NO captions, no poster text, no extra bottles, no upright standing packshot. SCENE: extremely crispy thick golden crinkle fries piled high in a small off-white bowl tilted slightly toward camera, dominant close foreground. Truffle mayo pale warm ivory ribbon freshly flowing over the ridges and slowly draping between fries. Two or three fries falling into pile, a tiny few thyme leaves and very thin mushroom slices in air, not a mess. Clean rich muted mushroom-taupe studio background with warm light, no green/red background. Bottle says 트러플표고마요. Focus on hot golden fry texture and luxurious real cream sauce. Low food-level camera angle; sauce landing center.

prompts.name: easy-mayo-concept-fries-base-v5.png
prompts.prompt: Precisely edit this food photograph for compositing with an untouched real product photo later. REMOVE the entire bottle, cap, hand and arm from the upper-right of the image. REMOVE the raised sauce stream coming out of the nozzle, but KEEP the beautiful creamy sauce already deposited ON the food. Reconstruct only the natural blurred taupe/kitchen background behind the removed objects. Preserve all existing food, airborne garnishes, lighting, crop and colors as much as possible. At x=80% of canvas width and y=70% of canvas height ensure there is a small glossy pale beige sauce landing mound on the food, so a real thin stream can be overlaid onto it later. Keep the food as the delicious main foreground. No bottle, no hand, no lid, no text, no standing vertical sauce stream anywhere above the food. The upper-right 40% of frame must be clean background, suitable to receive a real hand-held product overlay. Output same wide 16:9 composition.
